p5908.why: its whole Effect is darkvision and seeing invisible creatures adjacent to you. Being unseen is the HIDDEN_FROM relation and nothing suppresses it from the looker's side, and there is no light for darkvision to answer

p6959.wants: c.summon / c.conjure taking an inline stat line plus a commanded action
p6959.why: a summoning row: the printed Effect is a creature with its own hit points that the summoner commands with a standard or opportunity action. c.summon(ref) needs a content ref for the creature and there is none; c.conjure has no hit points, so 'if it is reduced to 0 hit points' can never happen, and no door for 'you can give it the following special command' -- which is most of what the row prints. It also targets one dead creature and takes that creature's size and reach, neither of which is readable off a corpse
